instruction: Speak in Russian. Recount this story in a surprised and excited tone, letting your volume and pitch fluctuate throughout, getting louder and higher on the most unbelievable parts.
text: Ты не поверишь, я иду по улице, и вдруг вижу огромную толпу, а в центре стоит слон, представляешь, настоящий живой слон!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic instruction, starting relatively normal and becoming noticeably louder and higher in pitch on the most unbelievable parts, while maintaining an excited and surprised tone.

instruction_evidence.emotion: The speaker sounds consistently surprised and genuinely excited.
instruction_evidence.dynamic_fluctuation: Volume and pitch escalate appropriately, especially peaking on 'огромную толпу' and 'настоящий живой слон'.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech exhibits some robotic cadence and synthetic artifacts, especially in the first half.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emphatic pauses at the end and the dramatic shifts in volume and pitch make the delivery highly expressive and engaging.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this with a steady crescendo, beginning almost inaudibly and ending with a powerful, loud voice.
text: Сначала был только шепот надежды, потом он перерос в уверенный голос, а теперь это крик целого народа, который требует перемен!

target_values.volume: begin very quiet and build up to very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The requested dynamic progression is absent. The audio begins at a normal volume rather than almost inaudibly, and fails to build up to a powerful, loud voice by the end.

instruction_evidence.beginning almost inaudibly: The opening phrase is delivered at a standard, fully audible conversational volume.
instruction_evidence.steady crescendo ending loud: There is no significant volume build-up. The delivery remains relatively flat throughout, and the ending is not a powerful or loud voice.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin speaking in a happy and playful tone, but about halfway through, shift to a sad and disappointed tone.
text: О, я выиграл билеты на концерт, как здорово, мы так давно хотели пойти... ой, подожди, это же на прошлую неделю.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic instruction, starting with an upbeat tone and successfully shifting to a disappointed tone in the second half.

instruction_evidence.start_happy_playful: The first half is delivered with an upbeat pace and higher pitch, reflecting excitement and happiness.
instruction_evidence.shift_to_sad_disappointed: A clear tonal shift occurs at 'ой, подожди', marked by a lowered pitch and slower, disappointed delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice exhibits noticeable synthetic stiffness and a somewhat robotic rhythm, lacking full human smoothness.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressive contrast between the two emotional stages is clearly shaped and effectively highlights the intended dynamic shift.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin at a slow pace and steadily accelerate your speech throughout the sentence, finishing at a very fast speed.
text: Круговорот воды в природе представляет собой сложный и непрерывный процесс, в ходе которого вода испаряется с поверхности океанов и суши, поднимается в атмосферу, конденсируется в облака и в конечном итоге возвращается на землю в виде осадков, питая реки и озёра.

target_values.speed: start slow, gradually accelerate to very fast

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The dynamic speed progression is entirely missing. The audio does not start at a slow pace, but rather maintains a consistently fast tempo throughout the entire sentence.

instruction_evidence.start_slow: The beginning of the audio is already spoken at a brisk, fast pace, lacking the requested slow start.
instruction_evidence.steady_acceleration: There is no perceptible acceleration; the pace remains relatively uniform and fast from start to finish.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Switch back and forth between a pleading and a defiant tone as you read the different phrases in this sentence.
text: Я умоляю тебя, пойми меня, но я никогда не соглашусь на это; неужели ты не видишь, ведь это мое окончательное решение.

target_values.tone: alternate between a pleading tone and a defiant tone

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is heavily flattened. While there are very subtle shifts in pitch and firmness, the intended alternation between clearly pleading and clearly defiant tones is too weak and lacks the required emotional contrast.

instruction_evidence.pleading_tone: The first phrase ('Я умоляю тебя...') sounds slightly softer but lacks genuine pleading emotion.
instruction_evidence.defiant_tone: The defiant phrases ('но я никогда...') are slightly firmer but not strong enough to convey true defiance.
instruction_evidence.alternating_dynamics: The shifts between the two emotional states are poorly realized and sound mostly monotonous and synthetic.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds robotic and has obvious synthetic stiffness.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery lacks rich and appropriate emotional variation, sounding very flat overall.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off by giving the instructions quickly and with an urging tone, then slow down and shift into a complaining tone as you finish.
text: Так, быстро бери эти коробки, неси их на склад и раскладывай по полкам... господи, почему этим всегда приходится заниматься именно мне.

target_values.speed: start fast and then become slow
target_values.tone: begin with an urging tone, but then shift to a complaining one

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully implements the dynamic changes in both speed and tone. The first part is delivered quickly with an urging tone, and the second part slows down significantly with a clear complaining tone.

instruction_evidence.speed_change: The speaking rate is fast during the first sentence and notably slows down after the pause.
instruction_evidence.tone_change: The tone starts off as authoritative and urging, then clearly shifts to a frustrated, complaining demeanor for the final phrase.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like, and the transition between the two distinct emotional states feels natural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery exhibits excellent and rich expressive variation, strongly enhancing the contrast between the urging command and the internal complaint.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin speaking quickly and with conviction, but let your voice trail off, becoming slow and hesitant by the end of the sentence.
text: Нет никаких сомнений в том, что это правильное решение для компании, оно принесет нам огромную прибыль... если, конечно, рынок отреагирует так, как мы предполагаем.

target_values.speed: start fast and then slow down to a crawl
target_values.tone: begin with a firm tone that becomes hesitant

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the requested dynamic change. The speaker starts at a quick pace with a firm tone and then shifts to a notably slower, more hesitant delivery in the second half.

instruction_evidence.speed_change: The first clause is spoken rapidly and fluidly, while the second half (after the pause) is delivered at a noticeably slower pace.
instruction_evidence.tone_change: The speaker's tone begins with conviction but loses its energy, trailing off into a hesitant and less confident delivery at the end.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds natural, and the pause perfectly matches the punctuation and semantic shift without any robotic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional transition from confidence to doubt is portrayed convincingly with appropriate changes in pacing and energy.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin your speech with a loud, high-pitched, and happy voice. Gradually let your voice become quieter, lower in pitch, and emotionally neutral as if you are running out of steam.
text: Лучший день в моей жизни! Утром мне сделали предложение! Я так счастлива, я кричала от радости! Мы весь день праздновали, гуляли по городу, ели в ресторане. Было просто волшебно. А сейчас уже поздно, я очень устала. Нужно смыть макияж, переодеться и просто лечь. Завтра будет много дел.

target_values.emotion: start happy, but gradually fade to neutral
target_values.volume: start loud and gradually fade to very quiet
target_values.pitch: start high and gradually fall to low

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully follows the complex dynamic instruction, starting loud, high-pitched, and happy, and gradually transitioning to a quieter, lower-pitched, and neutral delivery. However, the high pitch at the beginning is achieved through very noticeable synthetic pitch-shifting, which negatively impacts naturalness and expressiveness.

instruction_evidence.emotion_and_pitch_start: The speaker begins with a high pitch, high volume, and a clear happy emotion.
instruction_evidence.gradual_transition: As the text progresses, the pitch drops, the volume decreases, and the tone becomes more subdued and neutral, perfectly matching the 'running out of steam' instruction.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds highly synthetic, especially at the beginning where the high pitch sounds like a digitally manipulated male voice (chipmunk effect).
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: While the intended emotions and volume changes are present, the heavy artifacts and unnatural vocal timbre detract from the overall expressive quality.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off loud, fast, and angry. Then, transition into a sad tone, slowing down and getting quieter. End the sentence in a slow, quiet, thoughtful manner.
text: Почему ты никогда меня не слушал, я же столько раз говорил тебе об этом, а теперь уже слишком поздно что-то менять, и остается только принять это.

target_values.emotion: start angry, then transition to sad, and end on a thoughtful note

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic instruction, distinctly realizing the three requested stages of volume, speed, and emotion in the correct order. However, the emotional delivery sounds highly synthetic.

instruction_evidence.start_loud_fast_angry: The first section is delivered at a fast pace with a loud, strained, and agitated/angry tone.
instruction_evidence.transition_sad_slower_quieter: The middle section noticeably drops in volume and speed, adopting a distinctly sad, almost tearful vocal quality.
instruction_evidence.end_slow_quiet_thoughtful: The final phrase is spoken quietly and at a slower, more resigned and thoughtful pace.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The emotional expressions sound heavily synthesized, with obvious robotic artifacts and distortion during the transitions.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Despite the artifacts, the delivery exhibits strong, well-shaped expressive variations in volume, speed, and tone that perfectly map to the requested progression.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this in three stages: first, speak normally; second, become very slow, low-pitched and quiet; third, suddenly become very fast, high-pitched and loud.
text: Я шел по темному коридору, и вдруг в самом конце я увидел, как под дверью медленно пробивается тонкий лучик света... и внезапно дверь распахнулась!

target_values.pitch: normal, then drops to very low, then suddenly very high
target_values.speed: normal, then very slow, then suddenly very fast
target_values.volume: normal, then very quiet, then suddenly very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The required three-stage progression is largely absent. The speaker fails to transition to the third stage (fast, high-pitched, loud) and instead delivers the final phrase slowly and quietly.

instruction_evidence.stage_1: The first part is delivered at a normal pace and pitch.
instruction_evidence.stage_2_and_3: The second stage is delayed and the third stage is completely missing. The final exclamation is delivered slowly, quietly, and with a low pitch, contradicting the instruction for a fast, loud, and high-pitched finish.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Your voice should start low and neutral, then rise in pitch as you become worried, and end high and fearful.
text: Я смотрел на экран монитора, как вдруг он мигнул и погас, а затем из динамиков раздался тихий, искаженный голос.

target_values.pitch: start low and rise to high
target_values.emotion: from neutral to worried, then to fearful

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully demonstrates the requested dynamic progression, clearly starting low and neutral, rising in pitch with noticeable worry, and ending on a higher, fearful tone.

instruction_evidence.pitch: The pitch starts low, clearly rises in the middle of the sentence, and ends at a noticeably higher register.
instruction_evidence.emotion: The emotional progression is audible, shifting from a calm baseline to an urgent, worried middle section, and ending with a tense, fearful quality.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice has some noticeable synthetic artifacts and occasional robotic prosody, reducing its overall human-like quality.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery features well-shaped expressive variation that effectively conveys the building tension and fear over the course of the sentence.
